name: Cyberpunk Neon Alley
description: Rain-slick asphalt, neon signage and steaming vents.
palette: wet black asphalt, magenta and cyan neon, dirty concrete grey, sodium orange
lighting: saturated neon reflections on wet ground, deep shadow between signs
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: rain-slick cracked asphalt with reflective puddles and painted road markings
materials: A rain-slick cyberpunk back alley. Cracked wet asphalt with reflective puddles, graffiti-tagged concrete walls, dense holographic neon signage in magenta and cyan, tangled cabling and air-conditioning units, steaming street vents, overflowing dumpsters and stacked plastic crates, corrugated shutters.
boundary: tower blocks packed edge to edge, their flat tops wet with rain
